Coram : DEEPAK GUPTA*, ANIRUDDHA BOSE
Constitution of India – Art. 129 and 142 – Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 – s. 15 – The Rules to Regulate Proceedings for Contempt of the Supreme Court, 1975 – Powers of the Supreme Court of India in relation to dealing with contempt – The amicus curiae contended Court of Record is not bound by the provisions of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 – Held: A bare reading of Art.129 clearly shows that Supreme Court being a Court of Record shall have all the powers of such a Court of Record including the power to punish for contempt itself – This is
Decision Date : 27-04-2020 | Case No : SUO MOTO CONTEMPT PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 2/2019 | Disposal Nature : Directions issued | Direction Issue : Contemnors held guilty | Bench : 2 Judges
